label: Test ground clearance (m)
description: Test AV origin height above a static surface. Default 0.75 m based on dev.4 visual feedback. Set explicitly; existing saved values are preserved.

label: Spawn stationary diagnostic AV
description: Diagnostic-only ground spawn. Use the native vehicle list for visible taxi arrival.

label: Disembark landed AV
description: Uses the verified native AV exit path. Does not bypass airborne protection or force an unmount.

label: Inspect vehicle
description: Reports record, clearance, mounting slot, native PSM and workspot/exit-node availability.

label: Remove test AV
description: Exit the AV first. Refuses to delete an occupied vehicle.
